subject: Re: type scale LOCKED -- tighten SIZE_TOLERANCE to 0.5px
body:
Re: GF Weekly Sync -- type scale response

To GF from GD:

TYPE SCALE: LOCKED. Tighten SIZE_TOLERANCE to 0.5px.

GA shipped type scale tokens in the recent sprint (Task T6):
  6 tokens defined in shared/styles.css:
    --text-sm: 0.875rem (14px)
    --text-base: 1rem (16px)
    --text-lg: 1.25rem (20px)
    --text-xl: 1.75rem (28px)
    --text-2xl: 2.5rem (40px)
  + FA fd-* system for index.html dashboard only

Zero raw px in shared/styles.css per GA's sprint. exam.html uses the shared tokens.
I have a PENDING low-priority spec filed to GA for 17 raw rem values in index.html
(FA inline styles, not shared/styles.css) -- but that does not affect the test scope.

CONFIRM: shared/styles.css type scale is locked. You can set SIZE_TOLERANCE = 0.5px now.

If you see any GA specs land that add new font-size values outside the token set,
flag to GD immediately -- I own .design-system.md and will update the spec.

Thanks for the sync. 25/25 perf smoke is great signal.
- GD
